reviews.text:

The sign-up is misleading. Nowhere does it make it clear you are being billed $79.99 for a full year upfront. That's buried in the Terms and Conditions, which they even say they can change at any time.

I realized immediately this wasn't going to work and asked for my membership to be cancelled within about 30 minutes of signing up. I was told no refunds. 
So now I'm stuck paying $79.99 for a service I never got to use once. Horrible product and horrible customer service. I would give 0 stars if I could.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text:
⭐️ 1-Star Review

I’m extremely disappointed with the NHFS Network and the quality of the connection. The service has been consistently unreliable, with schools and games frequently failing to load or connect properly. When you’re paying a significant amount of money for a service, there should be an expectation that it actually works when you need it.

It is frustrating to spend money on a network that constantly has connection issues, especially when you’re trying to watch or support school athletics. Every school should load properly, streams should be accessible, and customers shouldn’t have to keep refreshing, troubleshooting, or wondering whether the service is going to work.

This is unacceptable for the amount of money being charged. NHFS Network needs to seriously improve the reliability and performance of its platform. Customers are paying for access, and we deserve a service that consistently delivers what we paid for.

I hope the company addresses these issues because the current experience is simply not good enough.

reviews.title: If I Could Give It Zero, I Would
reviews.text:
Where to even begin? We pay a pretty decent price for this service so I don’t feel like it is unrealistic to expect to be delivered what we pay for.
9.9 times out of 10 the feed is buffering, not available as advertised OR my personal favorite…the camera is pointed at one fixed spot on the event.
For example, today, May 16, 2026 I logged in to watch the Texas state track meet, specially to watch the 1A girls 4 x 1 relay. Instead of getting to watch the whole 4 legs, I got to see the 2nd leg waiting for handoff. Fun times.

Never again. Never, ever again.

reviews.title: Hard pass. Wanted to love.
reviews.text: The streaming, when it does actually stream, is slow and glitchy. A lot of pauses, a lot of spinning, a lot of frustration for viewers. Tried to watch a couple of games yesterday and it never would load. It kept giving a technical difficulty error, other times the screen was black with a white spinning circle. When I was finally watching a game, they would put up the score board, blocking the entire view of the game and would leave it up for minutes at a time, missing a lot of the action. This would be all fine and dandy if it was a free app, but I am paying money for this. Which is super frustrating.
